title: Sliding window loop drops final window — off-by-one in range
description: Loop yields N - W instead of N - W + 1 averages as documented. smooth([1,2,3,4,5,6,7]) with window_size=5 returns 2 values instead of 3; when len(readings) == window_size, returns [] instead of single average. detect_anomalies inherits this: trailing readings never checked for anomalies. Fix: range(len(readings) - self.window_size + 1)
